provenance.note: The energy minimum differs by calibre (4100 to 5500 J) and is not stored. Any magnification and trigger weight are allowed. A bipod is required. The 10 min cover the scored shots of this distance. Sighters are on 300 m only, but the rule book gives both 3 and 5, so no count is set.
